patterns: APPSC asks single facts with a trap: Gandhi failed at Noakhali, Bill introduced 4 July (not passed), 'Act without a constitution', Radcliffe knew nothing of India, India Divided = Rajendra Prasad.
Other PSCs repeat: first GG (Mountbatten) vs last/only Indian GG (Rajaji), Kripalani as INC president, royal assent 18 July, Plan Balkan = Mountbatten, 'one-man boundary force'.
Book-author matching (India Divided, India Wins Freedom, Guilty Men) is a recurring side angle.
App MCQs are mostly on-depth; a few add contested claims (GoI Act 1935 basis, first GG assent) that are best avoided.
